name: BackgroundWorker
label: Queue Workers
description: Consumers of the TaskIQ group in the Redis Stream — a live snapshot, nothing is stored in the DB. A worker that crashed and did not restart stays here as a 'dead' consumer until someone removes it.

fields.label: In progress
fields.description: How many tasks this worker currently holds (delivered, not acknowledged).

fields.label: Idle, ms
fields.description: Time since the worker last interacted with the queue.

fields.label: Without finished tasks, ms
fields.description: Time since the last successfully acknowledged (ack) task.
